title: Relic Survey
summary: A relic-discovery template with Lens scans, research Index pages, missions, ambience, and map signals.
body: A mystic-tech and relic-discovery starter that focuses on scanning, research, stability, and artifact safety without Ashfall finale lore.
steps: Scan before interacting with unknown relics.
Use Index research pages to explain stability and risk.
Use HoloMap markers for signals the player should revisit.
commonMistakes: Vanilla-only packs with no discovery mechanics
